newsitem.title: FRANCE: Orpar holding extends control of Remy.
newsitem.headline: Orpar holding extends control of Remy.

text.p: The Orpar holding firm controlled by the Heriard Dubreuil family increased its stake in drinks group Remy-Cointreau to 63.05 percent last month from 62.60 percent a year earlier after the payment of dividends in shares, Remy said on Tuesday.

The proportion held by the public decreased to 28.82 percent from 29 percent, and the share held by Pierre Cointreau slipped to 8.13 percent as of November 14 from 8.4 percent, it said in a statement issued at a news conference.
It said 1,278,989 new shares were created, bringing the total to 38,113,413, through the payment of dividends in shares.
